list: These cabinets, old as Ding Feng Lou, are a symbol of the tearoom. Just like the shop, they have been integrating the latest materials for centuries. Today, a door; tomorrow, a panel—they may look ancient, but they keep up with the times.

Elegant, tranquil ceiling light. The great poet, beyond drunk, insisted on etching a poem on the 'third moon'. The staff, unflustered, brought out a cup of tea. Looking into it, the 'moon' was reflected. With a laugh, the light was spared.

The snacks on this tea table vary with the seasons. When the academy announces exam results, Ding Feng Lou offers 'Scholar Cakes' at half price for students—free if the taste inspires a poem. On such days, the porch is filled with poetry.

Shortly after opening, there was a fire. Broke from repairs, even the benches had to be gifted by neighbors. After the first profitable month, the owner returned the favor with tea. Since then, generations have enjoyed month-end discounts.

Simple and clean woven carpet. Each chosen successor must, as their final task, install this carpet throughout Ding Feng Lou. To become the new owner, one must first bow one's head and show respect for what they are about to inherit.

With the addition of the voice, the teapot has become the most popular 'employee'. A soldier bound for Yumen once had a lively conversation with it, alone by the window. As the years pass, it is vital to say goodbye to each of our friends.

The lotus leaves in the jar are carefully tended. As the best restaurant in Baizao, the shop is considered a feng shui treasure—businessmen touch the lotus leaves on display for good luck. They even serve a pastry set named Precious Lotus.

Panoramic display showing the twin full moons rising outside the teahouse. 'We all have people we'll never see again. So instead of sinking into despair, let's celebrate our last meeting. Let's drink our fill! ...of tea, of course. Haha.'

The well-maintained floorboards, as old as the shop itself, still sometimes creak. Countless visiting chefs have stood here. The staff will recognize them at once and escort them to the kitchen. For the nervous, calming tea is offered.
theme: A recreation of the Ding Feng Lou Teahouse, based on Blaze's description. The fact that Baizao restaurants had dedicated spaces for drinking tea left a deep impression on her. 'Just one sip and you can taste six or seven different flavors.'

list:
Under the full moon in Baizao, you have witnessed so many reunions and separations.
Put out enough bowls and chopsticks to accommodate all the invited guests. If you wait long enough, they may just all show up.
During the Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event, obtain Operator Xingzhu

You accepted the historian's family visit application, along with a carefully selected Yanese delicacy.
You have heard from your operators of her talent, her story, and her regrets. Soon, you will watch her write a new chapter in her own history.
During the Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event, consume 2400 'Yum-yum!' in [Savors at Yu's]

You've become a regular at Savors at Yu's and have started chatting with the owner as he picks the vegetables.
You know every piece of town gossip—when the fowlbeast will return from the neighbor's roof, which nursery rhyme the scallion-seller's grandson just learned—absolutely everything.
Complete all stages in [Flavor of Food] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

You were invited to attend a grand feast.
There is no one specific 'Baizao taste'. Instead, Baizao has all the flavors under the sun: spicy, sweet, tangy, salty—you get the idea. Visitors from all over the world find a sense of belonging here.
Complete all the content in [Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture] and collect the rewards

You helped the author of 'Baizao Cuisine & Food Culture' finish her book.
Some readers see a vivid depiction of Baizao's prosperity, while others glimpse her personal memories woven throughout its pages.
Complete OR-8 with a 3-star rating with no more than 3 Sapidity or Vapidity consumed by Wealth

You visited one of the nodes in Baizao's efficient food supply chain and stopped a thief from stealing food.
You seized two taels of animal meat from the thief, perfectly balanced at a 3:7 fat-to-lean ratio. 'Why only two taels? Because I only take what I can eat. It's a crime to waste food!'
Clear OR-EX-2 with a 3-star rating and make 'Humility' fall into pits at least 5 times

You accepted an invitation to drink—and managed to get your companion completely hammered.
At a banquet, a few drinks are meant to lift the mood, but if someone insists on more, you will be compelled to match their zeal with even heartier toasts.
Complete all stages in [Flavor of Life] on Challenge Mode

You have taken in the city's thriving grandeur.
There are those who are sacrificed and those who make choices. You witnessed the hidden price of this prosperity.
Complete all stages in [Farewell, Loved Ones] on Challenge Mode

You listened to your friend list their regrets.
Life is bitter and short; reunions are few, but partings are many. There are also those you shall never see again.
During the Such is the Joy of Our Reunion event, trigger 'Sapid Auspice' at least 10 times in total

While out on a stroll, you absorb the city's vibrant charm.
The snack shop just outside the Academy gates, the food stand on your way home from work, the luxurious restaurant that caters grand birthday banquets—in Baizao, there is a different flavor for each stage of life.
set: Such is the Joy of Our Reunion Engraved Medal Set

An engraved medal set depicting the customs of Baizao and the joys and sorrows that occurred there.
Three meals a day—breakfast, lunch, and dinner. They encapsulate the vast array of life's diverse experiences. Yet, at their core, they're simply a handful of ingredients—melding together to create the spice of life.
